entries.title: Psalms 17:1
segments: ¶<<A Prayer of David.>> Hear a just cause, O LORD, Attend to my cry; Give ear to my prayer [which is] not from deceitful lips.

entries.title: Psalms 17:2
segments: Let my vindication come from Your presence; Let Your eyes look on the things that are upright.

entries.title: Psalms 17:3
segments: You have tested my heart; You have visited [me] in the night; You have tried me and have found nothing; I have purposed that my mouth shall not transgress.

entries.title: Psalms 17:4
segments: Concerning the works of men, By the word of Your lips, I have kept away from the paths of the destroyer.

entries.title: Psalms 17:5
segments: Uphold my steps in Your paths, [That] my footsteps may not slip.

entries.title: Psalms 17:6
segments: I have called upon You, for You will hear me, O God; Incline Your ear to me, [and] hear my speech.

entries.title: Psalms 17:7
segments: Show Your marvelous lovingkindness by Your right hand, O You who save those who trust [in You] From those who rise up [against them].

entries.title: Psalms 17:8
segments: ¶Keep me as the apple of Your eye; Hide me under the shadow of Your wings,

entries.title: Psalms 17:9
segments: From the wicked who oppress me, [From] my deadly enemies who surround me.

entries.title: Psalms 17:10
segments: They have closed up their fat [hearts]; With their mouths they speak proudly.

entries.title: Psalms 17:11
segments: They have now surrounded us in our steps; They have set their eyes, crouching down to the earth,

entries.title: Psalms 17:12
segments: As a lion is eager to tear his prey, And like a young lion lurking in secret places.

entries.title: Psalms 17:13
segments: Arise, O LORD, Confront him, cast him down; Deliver my life from the wicked with Your sword,

entries.title: Psalms 17:14
segments: With Your hand from men, O LORD, From men of the world [who have] their portion in [this] life, And whose belly You fill with Your hidden treasure. They are satisfied with children, And leave the rest of their [possession] for their babes.

entries.title: Psalms 17:15
segments: As for me, I will see Your face in righteousness; I shall be satisfied when I awake in Your likeness.
